description: This file contains classes and functions for handling HTTP requests and server environment in a web server framework, including request parsing, headers, cookies, authentication, and input stream management.

classes.description: Holds environment configuration and server state information.

classes.description: Represents an HTTP request, parsing URL, headers, body, cookies, and authentication.

classes.description: Dictionary-like interface for HTTP request headers.

classes.description: Represents a cookie with attributes and string output.

classes.name: MultiDict
classes.description: Dictionary supporting multiple values per key, used for headers and form data.
